articles.headline: Gas Is Back at $4, but a Top Commodity Analyst Says the Real Pain Is in Diesel
articles.summary: Gas is back at $4, but analyst Matt Smith says diesel near $172 a barrel is the real threat, fueling inflation risks and near-record refiner margins.
articles._summary: The national average price of gasoline hit $4 a gallon on Monday, up 15% in a week, as conflict in the Strait of Hormuz spread to Saudi Arabia. But one commodity analyst says drivers are looking at the wrong number. “The pain has essentially been transferred from the oil price across to the products,” Matt Smith , director of commodity research at Kpler, said on Monday’s Prof G Markets podcast .
articles._zh_headline: 汽油价格回到 4 美元，但一位顶级大宗商品分析师表示，真正的痛苦在于柴油
articles._zh_summary: 随着霍尔木兹海峡的冲突蔓延到沙特阿拉伯，周一全国汽油平均价格达到每加仑 4 美元，一周内上涨 15%。但一位大宗商品分析师表示，司机们看到的数字是错误的。 Kpler 大宗商品研究主管马特·史密斯 (Matt Smith) 在周一的 G Markets 教授播客中表示：“痛苦基本上已经从油价转移到了产品上。”
